ui.network.applied_reopen_at: Applied. Reopen the panel at http://{address}.
ui.network.applied_reopen_new: Applied. Reopen the panel at its new address.
ui.network.apply_interface_hint: Reconfigures this interface, then reloads the firewall and DHCP.
ui.network.apply_mode_hint: Rewrites the interface roles and reloads the firewall.
ui.network.apply_panel_port_hint: Restarts the panel service and follows it to the new port.
ui.network.apply_routing_hint: Reloads the firewall and rebuilds the uplink routes.
ui.network.apply_upstream_hint: Rewrites the default route and reloads the firewall.
ui.network.balance_description: Whether connections are spread across the separate upstream lines. Two ports onto one line still count as one, so this only does something with two real connections.
ui.network.dhcp_toggle_description: Whether this network hands out addresses. The gateway answers DNS on it either way.
ui.network.error_address_in_pool: The gateway address must lie outside the pool.
ui.network.error_ap_ssid: Name the network this interface will publish.
ui.network.error_gateway_subnet: The gateway must sit inside this subnet.
ui.network.error_lan_address: Enter a valid IPv4 address, e.g. 192.168.100.1
ui.network.error_lease_time: Use a dnsmasq duration such as 12h, 30m or 1d.
ui.network.error_mac: Enter a MAC such as aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff.
ui.network.error_prefix_len: Prefix length must be between 1 and 32.
ui.network.error_range_order: The end of the range must not precede its start.
ui.network.error_upstream_is_self: That is the gateway's own address; name the network's real router.
ui.network.error_wan_gateway: A static uplink needs a gateway address.
ui.network.exposure_hint: The networks on which this box accepts connections to its own services: the panel, SSH, DNS, the shares.
ui.network.field_cloned_mac_hint: Leave blank to keep the hardware address.
ui.network.field_lan_address_hint: Clients get this as their gateway and resolver.
ui.network.intent_auto_hint: Let the gateway place this uplink.
ui.network.intent_backup_hint: Use only when no other uplink is left.
ui.network.intent_primary_hint: Pin it ahead of the ranking.
ui.network.inter_lan_description: Whether devices on one of the gateway's networks can reach devices on another. Every network reaches the internet and the overlay either way.
ui.network.method_dhcp_hint: Take an address from the upstream network.
ui.network.method_static_hint: Set the address and gateway by hand.
ui.network.mode_hint: What this machine is. Every section below it follows from the answer.
ui.network.mode_summary_router: Routes between uplinks and the networks it serves.
ui.network.mode_summary_server: Routes nothing; answers where it is reached.
ui.network.mode_summary_side_gateway: Forwards for hosts that name it as their gateway.
ui.network.panel_move_lost: No answer at {origin}. Open it again once the panel is reachable from here.
ui.network.panel_port_hint: The TCP port this panel listens on, on every exposed interface.
ui.network.priority_hint: The gateway ranks the uplinks itself, from which of them share one upstream line, which are wired, and what each negotiated. Say something here only where it would get that wrong.
ui.network.role_blocked_hint: No access-point mode on this card.
ui.network.role_blocked_modem: {name} is a modem: the carrier gives it one address and nothing to serve
ui.network.saved_forget_body: The passphrase is deleted and no radio joins this network again.
ui.network.saved_hint: Every radio in the WAN role joins whichever of these it can see, preferring the one highest in this list.
ui.network.saved_needs_passphrase_title: Its key was held somewhere this could not read. Pick it from a scan to type one.
ui.network.title: Network
ui.network.upstream_address_hint: Where this box sends what it forwards.
ui.network.upstream_hint: The router of the network this box forwards for. Devices reach the proxy by naming this box as their gateway; the network's own router keeps handing out its leases.
ui.network.vlan_id_range: The VLAN id must be {min} to {max}.
ui.network.vlan_id_taken: VLAN {id} is already on this trunk.
ui.network.vlans_footer: Each VLAN becomes its own interface, configured from its tab once applied.
ui.network.vlans_hint: Untagged traffic is the main interface; each VLAN rides tagged beside it.
ui.network.warning_address_reassigned: The address {name} serves is reassigned and its leases are reissued.
ui.network.warning_addressing_returned: Interface management returns to this machine's network manager.
ui.network.warning_addressing_taken: Interface management passes to Neutrino and addresses are reassigned.
ui.network.warning_cut_off_many: {count} devices reach the hub on {where}. Closing it ends their link.
ui.network.warning_cut_off_one: 1 device reaches the hub on {where}. Closing it ends its link.
ui.network.warning_panel_restart: The panel restarts on the new port.
ui.network.warning_uplink_exposed: {names} faces the internet, and exposing it accepts connections there on every port this box listens on.
ui.network.warning_vlans_removed: {names} and the networks they serve are removed.
ui.network.wifi_scan_hint: Scan for networks; joining sets this interface to WAN.
ui.overlay.apply_engine_hint: Switches which overlay this box is on.
ui.overlay.engine_hint: How this box is reached from outside. The section below it follows from the answer.
ui.overlay.exposure_hint: Whether this box answers on the overlay is set under Network, Exposure.
ui.overlay.install_first: NetBird is not installed. Applying the engine above installs it.
ui.overlay.join_step_key: Copy the setup key it shows and paste it below.
ui.overlay.join_step_network: In the console, open Networks and press Add Network.
ui.overlay.join_step_peer: On the new network, under Routing Peers, press Add and choose Install NetBird.
ui.overlay.management_unreachable: Management plane unreachable. If behind a filter, enable "Route this gateway's own traffic" on the Proxy page.
ui.overlay.none_body: Nothing reaches this box from outside. Pick an engine above to open a way in.
ui.overlay.peers_empty: No peers yet. Log in on another device with the NetBird app.
ui.overlay.reenroll_warning: Re-enrolling gives this gateway a new identity on the network. Afterwards, delete the old peer entry in the console.
ui.overlay.routes_empty: No interface has the LAN role.
ui.overlay.routes_hint: In the console under Networks, add each subnet below as a Resource of your network, and give it an Access Control Policy so peers may use the route.
ui.overlay.summary_easytier: Peer to peer, with no management plane of its own.
ui.overlay.summary_netbird: A private network over the public internet, on NetBird's management plane.
ui.overlay.summary_none: Nothing reaches this box from outside.
ui.overlay.title: Overlay
ui.overlay.warning_leaving: {title} stops and the way into this box from outside closes.
ui.proxy.apply_nodes_hint: Loads the exit nodes into the running proxy.
ui.proxy.apply_ports_hint: Rewrites the xray inbounds and reloads the proxy.
ui.proxy.apply_route_hint: Rewrites the xray routing rules and reloads the proxy.
ui.proxy.dead_exits: Every enabled exit node is unreachable. Traffic sent to the proxy (the LAN's names included) fails until one answers.
ui.proxy.dead_exits_fallback: Every enabled exit node is unreachable, so traffic sent to the proxy is leaving through the WAN instead, under this machine's own address.
ui.proxy.direct_dns_hint: Answers direct-list names, and all names while the proxy is off.
ui.proxy.direct_domains_description: xray rule syntax: geosite:cn, domain:example.com, keyword:baidu.
ui.proxy.direct_ips_label: IP ranges that bypass the proxy
ui.proxy.fallback_toggle: Let traffic out directly when no exit node answers
ui.proxy.fallback_toggle_description: Whether traffic sent to the proxy leaves through the WAN when every enabled exit node is unreachable. Off, it fails instead, and so do the LAN's names, because they are resolved at the exit.
ui.proxy.geoip_body: Domains and IPs matching the direct lists below leave straight out of the WAN. Everything else that is sent to the proxy goes through the exit-node balancer. Turn this off to proxy absolutely everything that is sent.
ui.proxy.lan_toggle: Send LAN traffic through the proxy
ui.proxy.lan_toggle_description: Whether name resolution and connections from the LAN go through the proxy.
ui.proxy.lan_toggle_description_server: Whether name resolution and connections from the LAN go through the proxy. This box forwards no one's traffic in server mode, so there is no LAN to send.
ui.proxy.local_toggle: Send Neutrino Hub's own traffic through the proxy
ui.proxy.local_toggle_description: Whether name resolution and connections from Neutrino Hub itself go through the proxy. It works in any network mode, and independently of the LAN switch.
ui.proxy.node_remove_body: The exit node is deleted and its share link is not kept.
ui.proxy.nodes_empty_hint: Add one with a share link from your provider.
ui.proxy.nodes_hint: Where proxied traffic leaves the internet. The balancer picks between the enabled ones by the strategy below.
ui.proxy.port_direct_note: Appears to come from this network.
ui.proxy.port_exit_note: Split the way forwarded traffic is.
ui.proxy.ports_hint: SOCKS5 listeners, on every exposed interface. Each one either leaves straight out the uplink or goes out through the exit nodes.
ui.proxy.route_hint: Whose traffic goes through the exit nodes, and which destinations are left out of it.
ui.proxy.share_link_hint: Paste the link as the provider gives it.
ui.proxy.title: Proxy
ui.proxy.warning_restart: Restarts the proxy; connections through it drop.
